Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență

Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
You have a passion for technology and want to make the world a greener place? 
 Join the forefront of energy transition with E.ON's Digital Technology organization, as part of our technology in-house consulting, Expert Services. As a professional services organization, we collaborate closely with our business units, providing pivotal services that accelerate E.ON's ambitious Digital Transformation strategy.
 If you have a passion for leading the green transition with digital innovation, become a playmaker in our energetic and diverse team of more than 500 Expert Services consultants.
 Your Role – meaningful & rewarding
Design, implement, and maintain scalable and efficient data pipelines to support various use cases related to business intelligence, analytics and data science.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including project managers, data experts and business stakeholders, to understand business needs and build operational data-driven solutions that have global impact and scale to all E.ON countries
Take responsibility in the end-to-end lifecycle of projects, define scope and deliverables with the business and ensure timely delivery of high-quality solutions
Communicate findings, insights and decisions effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences
Foster a collaborative and innovative team environment and mentor junior colleagues
Share your ideas and convince to go new ways
 Your Profile – authentic & open-minded
Solid understanding of data engineering best practices, including data modeling, quality, scalability, and performance optimization.
Extensive professional experience in data engineering positions and a consulting background
Broad hands-on experience in building end-to-end production-ready data solutions
Experience with software development best practices and architectural patterns, including version control, continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD), monitoring, automation and testing
Experience in Microsoft Azure, Infrastructure-as-a-Code, GitLab as well as building secure cloud architectures
Experience with our technology stack which includes SQL, Python, DBT, Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Terraform, Spark
Excellent communication skills engaging various stakeholders matching the audience
Fluent in English
 Our Benefits – smart & useful
 Enjoy flexibility: 
A stable work environment that offers you the flexibility to have a personal and fulfilling work rhythm.
Flexible benefits package – choose what suits you best, from gym memberships to holidays, meals, or shopping vouchers.
 Recharge your battery: 
25 vacation days to help you maintain a healthy work-life balance.
Private medical insurance to support your well-being.
 Advance your development: 
Access to internal learning programs and online learning platforms to grow your skills and career.
 This is by far not all… We are looking forward to speaking with you about further benefits during the hiring process.
